'''Moranna Rosenberg''' is a [[human]] [[quest giver]] located in the crypt at the [[Hollow Web Cemetery]] in [[Gilneas]]. She is the leader of the [[Lupine Coven]], an order that seeks power and healthiness beyond what the human body is capable of, and to that end have accepted the worgen curse.<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|42|Vilest of Men}}</ref>

==Quests==
* {{questlong|Alliance|42|Dim Light in the Darkness}} {{questfinish}}
* {{questlong|Alliance|42|Vilest of Men}} {{queststartfinish}}
* {{questlong|Alliance|42|A Crossroads Deal}} {{queststart}}

==Quotes==
The Kirin Tor called [[Archmage Arugal|Arugal]] a charlatan using cheap parlor tricks to pass for a mage. If only they could have understood his genius and mine.

The so-called Worgen curse is a blessing; With Arugal's research, we can achieve immortality, never again to fear sickness or frailty, empowered as we are with strength beyond human comprehension.

We have yet to test the curse on races other than humans and dwarves, but we are not so depraved as to force it upon those unwilling.
